_help: Store-wide sale campaigns the client confirmed (campaign.py). While one runs (from .. until, inclusive) a batch whose theme is one of its themes uses it: the end card ('Black Friday Sale' + 'UP TO 60% OFF + FREE GIFTS'), the offer card's sub line, the gifts / bundle statics (only when the campaign has gifts / bundle_any), a sentence in the script's close, the engine's hooks, the ad copy and the strategy packet's facts; compliance accepts exactly these facts and phrases (approved), nothing more. Each product's own % (the site's price vs compare-at) stays the product's offer: the Hobo Bag is still '50% off', the 60% is only ever said of buying 2 or 3 bags together ('up to 60% off'). A new sale: add a campaign with the client's words in 'approved'. final_sale: the sale's items cannot be returned (its terms page), so no returns promise while it runs (compliance, ad copy, scripts).

campaigns.name: Black Friday Sale 2026
campaigns.approved: Wouter (owner), 2026-10-23: the Black Friday Sale went live on 23 October and runs until 30 November (Cyber Monday). Up to 50% off sitewide; 60% off bundles (2 or 3 bags bought together at 60% off the regular price); free gifts while stocks last: buy 2 bags, get a free mirrored jewellery box (worth $19.95); buy 3+ bags, get the jewellery box + a free cosmetic bag (together worth $44.90); only bags count, not accessories. The site banner (2026-10-23): 'EARLY BLACK FRIDAY: 50% OFF EVERYTHING | BUY 2 BAGS = 1 FREE GIFT | BUY 3 = 2 FREE GIFTS | ORDER TODAY WHILE STOCKS LAST!' | UPDATE Wouter (owner), 2026-10-26: the free gifts and the extra cart discount on bags are removed ('they're not coming back'); 'It's 50% OFF or you can say up to 60% OFF'; 60% is only on bundles 'like the 3 piece set', not any 2 bags; the site now has Early Black Friday messaging, a countdown in the announcement bar, 'Ships by' and delivery dates, and the 3-Piece Set as a 'Best Value' upgrade on the Hobo Bag page; during Black Friday no returns are accepted (final sale).
campaigns.banner: Early Black Friday – 50% off everything, up to 60% off
facts: Early Black Friday Sale: live now (from 23 October), it runs until 30 November (Cyber Monday). Black Friday is 27 November.
50% off everything sitewide (each bag's own % is on its offer card: the Hobo Bag is 50% off).
Up to 60% off: some bundles are 60% off, like the Hobo Bag 3-Piece Set. Say '60% off' only of the 3-Piece Set (or another named bundle), never of a single bag or of 'any 2 bags'.
No free gifts and no extra cart discount: both were removed by the owner on 26 October.
The Hobo Bag's product page offers the 3-Piece Set as the 'Best Value' upgrade.
Black Friday prices are live now: no need to wait.

Sale items are final sale: they cannot be returned (the site's Black Friday terms); faulty items are still covered and the 1-year warranty still applies. Never say 'easy returns', 'free returns' or 'send it back' in a Black Friday ad.
